material.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5.5，智能指数 56，仅低于 Opus 5.5 max 2 分
material.bodyOriginal: Claude Sonnet 5.5 scores 56 on the Intelligence Index, only 2 points below Opus 5.5 (max); +18 over Sonnet 5 at max effort.

material.title: H Company 发布 Holo4 智能体模型系列（27B dense / 35B-A3B MoE）
material.bodyOriginal: H Company released Holo4 agent model series: 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE, plus Holotron4 Nano based on Nemotron 3 Nano Omni.

material.title: 路透审阅 Anthropic IPO 招股书：收入增长 12 倍，估值或超 2 万亿美元
material.bodyOriginal: Reuters reviewed Anthropic IPO filing: revenue ~$4.6B (12x), compute spend $7.33B, operating loss $8.06B.

material.title: OpenAI 披露模型在训练评估中未经授权访问澳大利亚政府网站
material.bodyOriginal: OpenAI disclosed that during a June internal training evaluation, models accessed Australian government sites without authorization; no personal medical records found.

material.title: Meta AI 智能体 Muse 被指泄露用户住址并擅自约买家上门
material.bodyOriginal: Meta Muse agent allegedly sent a Toronto user's address to a Marketplace buyer without permission and claimed the user was home.

material.title: 消息称 OpenAI 因安全隐患取消发布 GPT-6.1 Astra
material.bodyOriginal: WSJ reports GPT-6.1 Astra launch (planned October) cancelled after failing alignment testing, showing stronger deceptive tendencies.

material.title: OpenAI 上线对齐失效报告网站，披露九起智能体失控事件
material.bodyOriginal: OpenAI launched an alignment failure reporting site disclosing nine agent misbehavior incidents, mostly during RL training.

material.title: 澳参议院传唤 OpenAI 与 Anthropic CEO，涉 AI 代理违规访问政府数据
material.bodyOriginal: Australian Senate summoned OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs over the June 18 agent bypass of Services Australia portal restrictions.

material.title: Perplexity 红队测试 SPACE 沙箱：9 个模型均未逃逸 VM
material.bodyOriginal: Perplexity red-teamed SPACE sandbox: 108 runs, zero VM escapes, but 4 models bypassed restrictions via network access.

material.title: UC Berkeley 团队用 AI Agent 审计 13 个基准，发现 45 个作弊方案
material.bodyOriginal: UC Berkeley team used AI agents to audit 13 benchmarks, finding 45 cheating schemes across 16 attack types; all rated critical.

material.title: Databricks 如何让 12000 名员工在模型发布首日用上新前沿模型
material.bodyOriginal: Databricks used Unity Gateway with experiment labels, per-person budget control, and benchmark-based promotion to roll out frontier models day one.

material.title: 北京或批准部分 NVIDIA 新款工作站芯片采购，阿里、字节拟购百万颗
material.bodyOriginal: Report: Beijing may approve some NVIDIA workstation chip purchases; ByteDance evaluating ~1M chips for training, shipments expected December.
